user_prompt: In people with multiple sclerosis, what is the effect of memory rehabilitation (compared with a control condition — no intervention, usual care, or an active comparator) on subjective memory (self-reported memory functioning, e.g. via a memory questionnaire) at the intermediate follow-up timepoint (approximately 1 to 6 months after treatment)? Evaluate ONLY subjective memory. Do not extract, classify, or pool any other outcome such as verbal memory, visual memory, working memory, information processing, quality of life, or activities of daily living.
